comments.author: Setsuna
comments.body:
Hi just wanna share something about this ship. Currently my adv/trade/maritime lvl r 21/36/39. I was grinding for maritime lvl and went to calicut (india) region. For those who been there will know that the npc/mob/priates there r mainly ceyron (cannons) or large gallary (melee 140 crews). The exp there is good for my lvl with 850-1010 exp. So i had been think if just use cannon how to deal with the melee part. Therefore i tried using this Modified Stacked Turtle Ship (only got 1 improvement: row assistance + iron platted + hori sails (+40) + dura 930. The ship a bit slow but i must really share that it's worth using this ship to train at calicut region.
Reasons: Evade melee (so those melee gallarys can't touch u with melee. However as they r program for melee, they will 90%++ tried to face in ur direction which allows ur cannon for crit hits :)). I can deal a crit of total 450damage (1 shot ko lol). 2ndly: Cannon pirates npc, although they use cannnon, but due to the dura not much damage was done (a crit from them only deals me 150++ to 210+), therefore i also can sink them fast.
At the end nothing much to worry for a bit slowness for this ship in battle, as the pirates in those region will try to get close to u instead of far distance. So using master cannonade w/o ballistic will still be able to hit them lol. Skill i use with this Modified Stacked Turtle Ship r mainly acc + pent + reloading, cannon use r master cannonade 1040-1088 16 x4. Crew use 170. Aide use ship for high cargo.

So i hope this information for the ship as well as for player who plan to grind in Calicut region r valuable.
